summary: Land-attack cruise missile (the Hong Niao / DH-10 family's), as the H-6K carries it under its wings. A body on its station and, released, an inert one: its turbofan, its wings and its guidance are not modelled

xinhua-cj10a-caution.title: Xinhua: CJ-10A in the Rocket Force parade context
xinhua-cj10a-caution.note: Identity caution: this original report describes the land-based Rocket Force context, not an H-6K air-launched installation. It does not establish equivalence with KD-20, CJ-20 or CJ-20A. Existing runtime identity remains unverified.

mass_kg.note: the family's heaviest (the page: 'the HN-3 at 0.75 m and 1,800 kg'; its table's HN-1, 'Launch Weight: 1,200 kg'); DH-10 and CJ-10 are its alternate names there, no figure given for the CJ-10A by name

length_m.note: the page's table: 'Length: 6.4 m (7.2 m inc. boost motor)' - air-launched, without the boost motor

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.02748, its base 0.01975, its fins' friction 0.00732 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 2.4792 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.923 for its fineness 8.5 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
